decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to generate value from sacrificing creatures and artifacts to trigger effects that benefit the player, all while utilizing the Sadistic Glee enchantment to pump up creatures and gain life. By combining sacrifice outlets like Deadly Dispute and Nadier's Nightblade with sacrifice fodder like Ichor Wellspring and Basking Broodscale, the deck aims to build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. This combo-centric strategy is supported by disruption cards like Duress and removal spells like Malevolent Rumble to control the game and secure a victory.

This Aggro - Affinity deck focuses on quickly flooding the battlefield with artifact creatures and using them to overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards that generate card advantage like Ichor Wellspring and Thoughtcast, as well as removal spells like Cast Down and Galvanic Blast to clear the way for attacks. Additionally, it includes synergistic cards like Vaults, Bridges, and Familiars to help reduce the cost of the powerful Myr Enforcer. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence to swiftly defeat the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, allowing for early plays of aggressive creatures like Avenging Hunter and Boarding Party. Malevolent Rumble helps control opposing boards, while powerful creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Eldrazi Repurposer put pressure on the opponent. Writhing Chrysalis provides a way to constantly produce threats, while cards like Generous Ent and Oliphaunt offer additional value and versatility. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient aggro strategy in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells and removing threats with burn spells. It utilizes card draw and scrying to dig for key cards, while also generating creatures for pressure and defense. The mana base is optimized for efficient casting of both blue and red spells. The deck aims to maintain board control and tempo throughout the game, ultimately outlasting the opponent with a combination of counterspells, removal, and creature threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of efficient creatures and powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The Gates archetype allows for strong mana fixing and card draw, while cards like Prismatic Strands and Counterspell provide protection and disruption. The deck includes a mix of creatures for defense and offense, as well as spells for card selection and control. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and establish dominance through careful resource management and strategic plays.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using removal spells and card advantage, while generating tokens with Khalni Garden and Thorn of the Black Rose to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with efficient removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down, while also gaining card advantage through Deadly Dispute and Eviscerator's Insight. With the help of Lembas and other creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm, the deck can outvalue opponents and close out the game with aggressive threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and creature-enhancing enchantments. By using ramp spells like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, the deck aims to get ahead on mana and play threats like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter early on. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Eldrazi Repurposer and Writhing Chrysalis, along with support cards like Malevolent Rumble and You Meet in a Tavern to help maintain board control and pressure the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl to play aggressive creatures, like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. The deck also includes cards like You Meet in a Tavern and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and disruption spells, while utilizing ramp to get ahead in the early game and close out the match quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Sadistic Glee combo, which involves sacrificing creatures and enchantments to deal damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes a combination of creatures, artifacts, and enchantments to generate value through sacrificing and card draw effects. It also includes removal spells and land destruction to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently assemble the combo pieces while controlling the board and overwhelming the opponent with incremental advantage.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By maintaining control of the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver its opponent until it can deploy powerful threats like Gurmag Angler and Lórien Revealed to close out the game. The deck also includes various ways to draw cards and manipulate the graveyard to ensure it has access to the resources it needs to control the game.

The focus of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced and aggressive approach using low-cost creatures and counterspells to control the tempo of the game. By utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets, Cryptic Serpent, and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their strategy with Counterspell, Spell Pierce, and Force Spike. Thought Scour and Mental Note help with card draw and graveyard manipulation, while Snap and Deep Analysis provide additional versatility and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through efficient spellcasting and proactive gameplay.

The deck focuses on efficiently casting cheap spells and creatures to put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cheap counterspells and bounce effects, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing its own board presence. The inclusion of card draw and graveyard interaction helps to maintain card advantage and fuel the powerful Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent. Overall, the deck seeks to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells to secure a victory.

This mono blue aggro deck focuses on quickly getting creatures on the board and using cheap spells to control the opponent's board. Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent provide early aggression, while Tolarian Terror and Lórien Revealed offer additional threats. Counterspells like Spell Pierce and Deem Inferior help protect your creatures, while card draw spells like Brainstorm and Thought Scour ensure you don't run out of steam. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast, efficient game plan.

This deck focuses on efficiently disrupting opponents while utilizing cheap and effective spells to control the board and maximize damage output. By combining disruptive spells like Counterspell and Boomerang with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, this deck is able to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game. Thought Scour and Brainstorm help to filter through the deck and enable graveyard synergy, while Lórien Revealed provides additional card advantage. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a combination of disruption and aggression.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Wild Growth to play powerful and aggressive creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures early in the game, backed up by cards like Generous Ent to provide additional support. Malevolent Rumble provides removal for opposing threats, while You Meet in a Tavern helps with card draw. The deck aims to apply pressure from the beginning and maintain a strong board presence to win the game quickly.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to control the board by countering spells, destroying creatures, and outvaluing the opponent with card advantage. It utilizes a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw to maintain control of the game. The deck also includes a few finisher creatures like Gurmag Angler and Thorn of the Black Rose to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Additionally, the deck includes some cheap evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite to pressure the opponent and provide additional card advantage.
